messages.author: 8bf0927cf6c5a784
messages.subject: Identifying Partially Methylated Domains
parts:
Is there a way to determine partially methylated domains (PMDs) in methylKit?

For example, in MethylSeekR, there is a segmentPMDs function:
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/MethylSeekR/versions/1.12.0/topics/segmentPMDs

If not, is there a recommended package that can do that from methylKit objects? For example, segmentPMDs takes a GRanges object, but it's unclear what columns that is supposed to have.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Identifying Partially Methylated Domains
parts:
I think methSeg() maybe able to do it but I have to look into it. MethylSeeker can definitely do it. You can convert methyKit objects to GRanges with as() you may need to create percent methylation column but that is just numCs/coverage

Look into examples in methylSeeker and not every methylome has PMDs afaik
